text: The UNDP Insurance and Risk Finance Facility (IRFF) in Nepal aims to enhance the country's financial resilience against natural catastrophes by integrating innovative insurance and risk finance solutions. The initiative focuses on policy and regulatory reforms, market development, and capacity building. It includes a sub-sovereign parametric flood insurance scheme, nature-related insurance for human-wildlife conflict, and agricultural insurance innovations leveraging AI and real-time monitoring. The program aligns with UNDP's broader guidance on integrating climate and disaster risk finance and insurance into national adaptation planning.
